title: Coordination of Benefits under Prescription Insurance on File: Primary, Secondary and the Secondary Billing Deadline
content:
## Clause 1 — Order of billing

When a patient has two open coverage records under **Prescription Insurance on File**, every fill is billed first to the primary plan and then, for the patient pay the primary assigned, to the secondary plan, the secondary claim being submitted on the coordination-of-benefits secondary basis. The patient's final pay is the secondary claim's patient pay.

## Clause 2 — Which plan is primary

(a) A plan class that is a payer of last resort is always the secondary, whatever the card says, and the other plan is set primary.

(b) A Medicare class and a commercial class held together follow the order the payers report: an employer plan of an active employee is primary and the Medicare class secondary; otherwise Medicare is primary.

## Clause 3 — When a secondary claim may be billed

A secondary claim is billed only where the secondary plan's class may be billed as secondary, and no later than the primary claim's date of service plus the secondary class's secondary billing window days. Calendar days are counted with the primary claim's date of service as day 0, and the last day of the window itself still qualifies. The date checked is the primary claim's date of service as the paid claim record shows it.

## Clause 4 — Savings programs are not coverage

A manufacturer copay card or discount program is never a coverage record; it is applied after all coverage under Savings & Copay Assistance Programs.

## Boundary cases for Clause 3 (hypothetical dates)

Suppose the secondary plan's class has a 90-day secondary billing window and the primary claim's date of service is 1 March.

| Secondary claim billed on | Day count from 1 March | Within the window? |
|---|---|---|
| 1 March | day 0 | Yes |
| 30 May | day 90 | Yes — the last qualifying day |
| 31 May | day 91 | No |

If the secondary plan's class may not be billed as secondary, no secondary claim is billed on any date.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical amounts)

A fill is billed to the primary plan, which assigns a patient pay of 40.00. The secondary plan is then billed for that 40.00 and assigns a patient pay of 10.00. The patient's final pay is 10.00, the secondary claim's patient pay.
